text: In January 2021, residents reached out to my office with an urgent concern about speeding along their street and requested via an online survey that traffic calming measures (speed humps) be installed as a method of addressing these concerns. Of those that responded, 91% were in support of making this change. I am requesting that speed humps be installed on Sheridan Avenue from College Street to Dundas Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Sheridan Avenue, between College Street and Dundas Street West. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Sheridan Avenue, between College Street and Dundas Street West, to install three speed humps, generally as shown on the copy of 'Drawing No. 421G-4005' dated April 2022 from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
